implementation.summary: D24 completes the bounded local P6 catalog-to-ontology-to-graph/RQL journey through the real SQLite/HTTP composition, exposes catalog, ontology and graph read operations in the public CLI, verifies the existing SDK against real HTTP, and makes the Graph Studio inherit workspace context and inspect the catalog-bound ontology schema.

commands.candidate_web: exact candidate sandbox npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts followed by npx playwright test tests/graph-studio.spec.mjs --workers=1 --timeout=30000
commands.candidate_static: exact candidate sandbox ruff format/check, mypy, architecture, negative gates, route consistency, dependency surfaces, OpenAPI, Studio surface and web audit
commands.scans: Gitleaks directory scan and pip-audit -r requirements-test.lock over the final clean sandbox; Trivy skipped because no local binary was available

security_and_recovery.workspace_scope: The real local composition stores the same graph id with different objects in two workspaces; direct HTTP, SDK and CLI reads stay in scope, an unknown workspace returns 403, an invalid CLI key is rejected, and the graph survives composition restart.
security_and_recovery.catalog_ontology_graph_binding: The journey persists a governed catalog asset and revision, persists a typed ontology whose Person type references that catalog revision, executes bounded RQL, lists graph objects and neighbors, and reads the same schema and graph after restart.
security_and_recovery.ui_contract: The Graph Studio inherits the active workspace, loads the catalog-bound ontology schema, executes query/object/neighbor flows and preserves the query form across a recoverable server error. Browser route fulfillment is UI contract evidence only and is not provider certification.
security_and_recovery.project_scope: The public catalog remains workspace-scoped; CatalogAsset.project_id is metadata only and no independent project-level filter or authorization claim is inferred.
security_and_recovery.action_scope: Graph action execution is still not mounted in the local composed control plane, so no action-provider or side-effect qualification is claimed.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: No PostgreSQL, Docker worker, external catalog or external graph provider was available or certified for D24; SQLite local composition is not substituted for those provider gates.
